windupMs.note: From the press to the moment the swing lands: the anticipation everyone sees coming

swingSkip.note: How much of the swing clip's own wind-up the hero skips (the windup above is what players wait for)

swingRestMs.note: How long after a swing lands before the next can start

swingArc.note: How wide the swing sweeps in front of the hero

hitStopMs.note: The hit lands: the struck hero holds, flashes and flinches before it flies

knockDistance.note: How far a hit sends a hero, the same at any frame rate

knockEase.note: 1 slides at one speed; higher leaves faster and eases into the stop

squash.note: How much a flying hero stretches along the hit, and squashes when it stops

flashMs.note: How long the struck hero flashes white

shake.note: The camera's kick when you hit or are hit

ringMs.note: How long a slash and a hit's ring last

jumpHeight.note: How high a jump goes (above 0.3 m a swing passes under)

jumpRise.note: How long it takes to reach the top

fallFaster.note: Down this much harder than up: higher feels heavier, snappier

fade.note: How long one clip takes to blend into the next

walkSpeed.note: The ground speed the walk clip's feet move at (feet slide when this is wrong)

runSpeed.note: The ground speed the run clip's feet move at

runFrom.note: From this speed up, the walk becomes a run

actSpeed.note: How fast the swing plays: higher is snappier

jumpStretch.note: How tall and thin a hero goes as it leaves the ground

landSquash.note: How flat it goes when it lands

squashHz.note: How fast the squash springs back (lower wobbles longer)

lean.note: How far a hero banks into a turn and tips into a sprint

flinch.note: How strongly a hit jolts the upper body

lookAt.note: How much the head turns toward what it looks at

spring.note: How loose tails, ears and capes are (0 stiff, 1 floppy)
